title: Error prone integration is broken
body:
Bazel forked different version for `checker_framework_dataflow` library > 2.0, as used in error prone itself: 1.8.10. To trigger the crash, specific bug pattern checks must be activated (that are not run per default). To reliably reproduce the problem on 0.4.2, apply this patch on Gerrit Code Review [1] and run:

FWIW, Buck error prone integration, implemented in this CL: [2] just works, as it consequently uses error prone and all transitive dependencies from error prone 2.0.15 release:

```
$ buck build --config sanitizers.error_prone=1 gerrit-server:server
```

And all error prone default warnings are reported in Buck log file:

```
$ cat buck-out/log/buck-0.log
[...]
[2016-12-16 10:15:52.928][debug][command:3c6161b6-8be7-4585-90df-469782c3c8e7][tid:52][com.facebook.buck.jvm.java.Jsr199Javac] javac: /home/davido/projects/gerrit/gerrit-server/src/main/java/com/google/gerrit/server/query/change/IsReviewedPredicate.java:55: warning: [ReferenceEquality] Comparison using reference equality instead of value equality
    return !reviewedBy.isEmpty() ? reviewedBy.contains(id) : id == NOT_REVIEWED;
                                                                ^
    (see http://errorprone.info/bugpattern/ReferenceEquality)
  Did you mean 'return !reviewedBy.isEmpty() ? reviewedBy.contains(id) : Objects.equals(id, NOT_REVIEWED);' or 'return !reviewedBy.isEmpty() ? reviewedBy.contains(id) : id.equals(NOT_REVIEWED);'?
[...]
```
